tools.name: get_card_prices
tools.description: Current sold prices for one card at every grade: raw (ungraded), PSA 7, PSA 8, PSA 9, PSA 10, BGS 9.5, CGC 10 and SGC 10, in US dollars, with the link to the card page for recent sales and price history. Take the card_id from search_cards. Needs a HobbyCardIndex API key.
